newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Semicon, Fujitsu in alliance.
newsitem.headline: LG Semicon, Fujitsu in alliance.

text.p: South Korean chipmaker LG Semicon Co, a unit of the LG Group, said on Thursday it had agreed with Fujitsu Ltd of Japan to form a strategic alliance in the chip packaging sector.
The two firms have integrated their chip packaging technology formats and agreed to cooperate to have the unified format designated as the world's standard, LG said.
The unified "ultra-thin small outline no-lead" package technology has been based on LG's "bottom leaded plastic" format and Fujitsu's "small outline no-lead" format, it said.
Based on the agreement, LG Semicon can also be a second source of Fujitsu's small outline no-lead technology while Fujitsu can be the second source of LG's technology, it said.
